### Task 4a — session-scoped muse toggle — BUILT, DEPLOYED

- **Design ruling recorded:** cross-session muse persistence is RETIRED — the toggle
  resets to OFF on every game load (session-scoped). Toggle-at-will within a session
  unchanged (the 09-16 UX ruling stands).
- **Implementation:** Quest scripts never receive `OnPlayerLoadGame` (proven twice in
  the Baka tree) and the framework broadcasts no load event, so the reset rides the
  codebase's proven cross-boot stamp-clamp pattern: activation stamps
  `GSAnim.MuseSetAt` (boot-relative); at the first `OnUpdate` after a load into a
  later boot, a stamp > the boot clock is stale → reset `GSAnim.Muse` to OFF +
  unconditional sentinel `muse session scope: reset to OFF on load`. The stateless
  grid footer label then agrees by construction.

### Task 1 — pending-scene latch — BUILT, DEPLOYED (Baka repo commit `7f5da83`)

- **Design:** `StorageUtil` int `SNBaka.PendingScene` per actor — the pair is marked
  busy from escalation dispatch until `_EscalationCleanup` confirms scene end. Set in
  `_DoEscalation` just before the dispatch branch (covers BOTH the PrismaUI wizard
  path and the automatic NPC-NPC scene path); released in `_EscalationCleanup` after
  the scene-end wait loop, placed BEFORE the invalid-actor guard so the latch never
  outlives the escalation even if the rest of the cleanup aborts (`_ClearSceneLatch`
  tolerates None/disabled actors). All escalation exits (cancel, automatic, wizard
  paths, hard-cap fallthrough, invalid-actor abort) flow through `_EscalationCleanup`
  — the release cannot be stranded.
- **Guard integration:** `IsEligible` consults the latch at BOTH `IsInSexAnimation`
  sites — the sentinel-bearing main guard (new log line "IsEligible: blocked — scene
  latch held, pair already escalating") and the quiet second check, mirroring the
  existing doubled structure.
- **Sentinels (1b):** `scene latch: SET — <A1> <-> <A2>` / `scene latch: RELEASED — …`
  / `IsEligible: blocked — scene latch held …` (the latch-blocked-attempt line).

### Task 2 — button/load-reset re-verification (4a field failure)

- **2a Probe verdict (source evidence, no build needed to conclude):**
  `OnPlayerLoadGame` IS declared in the installed SKSE source — `Actor.psc`
  L782 and `ActiveMagicEffect.psc` L349 — and **NOT on `Quest.psc`** (verified
  directly against the installed SKSE Scripts tree). ReferenceAlias:
  production proof exists in-tree — **`skynet_PlayerAlias` extends
  ReferenceAlias, receives `OnPlayerLoadGame()`, and calls
  `skynet.Maintenance()`** — that IS SkyrimNet's re-init-on-load path. So the
  prior "proven absent" finding was correct **only for Quest scripts** (Baka's
  own L8423/L8427 comments document this same limitation and work around it
  via the OnUpdateGameTime heartbeat, confirmed live in this session's log at
  22:24:39).
- **2b SkyrimNet broadcast check:** `Maintenance()` = `RunUpdate` +
  `libs.Maintenance` + `AddSpells` — **no ModEvent broadcast on load**; nothing
  to subscribe to (the only SendModEvent machinery is MinAIBridge's
  context/event channel, load-unrelated).
- **Honest options (user pick):**
  - **(A) ReferenceAlias reset (recommended):** a tiny always-running quest
    with a player ReferenceAlias whose one-line script traces on
    `OnPlayerLoadGame` and calls the GS/SNBaka reset — the exact pattern
    proven live by `skynet_PlayerAlias`. Deterministic same-session detection;
    the alias script doubles as the 2a minimal probe. Cost: a plugin edit
    (Build Patch is script-only today — first .esp-scope change).
  - **(B) ActiveMagicEffect variant** (ability on the player) — same
    determinism, same plugin cost, no advantage over (A).
  - **(C) Tightened stamp heuristic** (per-sweep stamp writes) — boot-detection
    only, NEVER same-session; the observed 4a failure (muse ON, label OFF, no
    reset) is exactly the same-session blind side, so (C) does not fix it.
  - **(D) Revert 4a** — accept persistent state + the stateless label.

  malformed — a full-file structural walk found the len field still read
  `2B 00` (43) while the payload was only 40 bytes, with a stray `26 00`
  inserted at the payload head (the intended new len value landed INSIDE the

  stray `01` in the LoadAlias payload is the STATUS BYTE (present in both live
  references), NOT garbage — an earlier read this rev misclassified it and was
  corrected before any wrong byte was shipped (the mistaken intermediate write
  was fully restored from `.bak-rev40` and redone; hashes below are final).

### Task 1 — ACHERON/DEFEAT INVESTIGATION: COMPLETE (all §7 report-only)

**1a. FORENSICS (Ivar Helgen window — Papyrus.0.log, 01:06:16–01:06:52):**

- **(i) Who claimed the deaths:** **Acheron core (Acheron.dll), by design.**
  Soldiers `0005CEEC`/`0005CEEE` (Helgen Keep, MQ101) were defeated by
  Acheron's death-alternative processing at lethal-HP; "defeated" =
  Acheron's `AcheronDefeated` keyword (per Acheron.psc API docs: "A defeated
  actor is bleeding out and immune to damage. A defeated actor is always
  pacified"). Attacks not killing them is EXACTLY that spec — not a bug in
  that part. Acheron's own `Validation.yml` deliberately ALLOWS processing
  during MQ101 (LocationA includes `GetStage MQ101 > 1 AND < 250 OR`) —
  the Helgen intro window is not protected by default.
- **(ii) Whose menu:** **Acheron's Hunter's Pride menu** (vanilla
  `AcheronHunterPride.swf`; the interaction perk `PRKF_AcheronInteraction`
  opens it on activating a defeated actor). NOT SNBaka/Baka — no
  SNBaka/Baka menu or pose grid appears anywhere in the window's 38 log
  lines. Trace: `[Acheron] OnHunterPrideSelect: 2 / [Actor < (0005CEEE)>]`
  (option 2 = Execute) at 01:06:31/39/52.
- **(iii) The half-execute (the actual bug):** `AcheronHunterPride.psc`
  option 2. With OpenAnimationReplacer + PairedAnimationImprovements both
  present (they are, in this install) AND MCM "Execution Animation" ON,
  the code plays `playIdleWithTarget(pa_HugA, akTarget)` — a paired HUG
  idle that stands the target up — and **contains no `akTarget.Kill()` in
  that branch**; the kill is evidently expected to come from a modded
  paired execution animation (OAR condition set) that is NOT installed
  here. Result: target stands up (the hug idle) while still carrying the
  defeated keyword + `ExecuteFaction` membership — the standing
  "defeated" zombie the user saw. Vanilla-Acheron code path, 100%
  reproducible from source reading.
- **(iv) OUR-CODE CLEARANCE: CLEAN.** The SNAcheron integration's
  presence in the window was: adoption of unclaimed defeats
  ("defeat ... never claimed by our consequence (none selected?) --
  adopting", 01:06:16) + `RunConsequence` handoffs sending
  `SNBaka_TryCreatureOnDowned` — which SNBaka REJECTED on the creature
  master switch OFF ("creature: master switch (bCreatureEscalation) is
  OFF"). No `baka_defeat` registration, no abandoned-hold watch trip, no
  `_ForceRecover`, no silence-watch on either soldier. Our paths observed
  and declined to act. The capture and the half-execute are both
  vanilla-Acheron behavior.

**1b. SETTINGS MAP (Acheron MCM as installed; menu paths exact):**

- **Who gets captured (Defeat page → "Condition: Lethal" + "Knockdown"):**
  - `fLethalNPC` slider "Condition: Lethal → NPC" — chance an NPC is defeated
    at HP 0 instead of dying. **The capture lever for goal A** (0% = hostile
    NPCs always simply die at 0 HP).
  - `bNPCDefeat` toggle "Allow NPC Defeat" — master gate for NPC defeats.
  - `fLethalPlayer` / `fLethalFollower` — same for player/followers.
  - `bLethalEssential` — essentials defeated instead of bleedout.
  - Validation.yml scope lists (actor-base/faction/location always-kill
    lists) are file-side, not MCM.
- **Execute semantics (General page → "Hunter's Pride"):**
  - `bHunterPrideKillAnim` toggle "**Execution Animation**" — "The default
    execute option will play a short execution animation. If disabled,
    executed NPCs will ragdoll and die without animation." **This is the
    half-execute lever:** OFF ⇒ `akTarget.Kill(PlayerRef)` fires directly
    (verified in AcheronHunterPride.psc:52-53). **The goal-B fix.**
  - `iHunterPrideKey`/`iHunterPrideModKey` — Hunter's Pride hotkey.
  - `bKillMove` toggle "Killmoves Enabled" (General page) — if killmoves
    fire, deaths happen before Acheron's defeat roll.
- **Predicted side effects (constraint check — downed pipeline):**
  - `fLethalNPC=0`/`bNPCDefeat=OFF` would ALSO stop Acheron captures that
    feed the SNAcheron `acheron_downed` trigger and DownedSkyrimNet
    consequences for NPC victims — the downed pipeline (Escalate/HelpUp/
    Release) is Baka-escalation-driven and ALSO fires from Baka's own
    QTE-defeat path (`_bQTEDefeated`, `_DefeatGroundWindow`), which is
    independent of Acheron. Player-victim chains (`fLethalPlayer`,
    player-defeat consequences) are untouched by an NPC-only setting.
  - `bHunterPrideKillAnim=OFF` has NO pipeline side effects — it only
    changes the Execute option's branch (direct Kill vs. anim).
    Killmove-permitted deaths reduce capture *frequency* but not scope.
  - **Conclusion: goal-B lever (`Execution Animation` OFF) is
    side-effect-free; goal-A lever (Lethal NPC → 0) amputates Acheron's
    NPC-down handoffs to our downed pipeline — NOT recommended while the
    downed-pipeline constraint stands.**

**1c. MITIGATION LADDER (presented, not built):**

- **Rung 1 (MCM) — RECOMMENDED:** Acheron MCM → General → Hunter's Pride →
  **Execution Animation OFF**. Mechanism: forces the direct
  `Kill(PlayerRef)` branch in OnHunterPrideSelect(2); Execute becomes a
  true finish-off; capture-into-downed stays (defeat-menu content
  unchanged: potion/loot/feed still route). Effort: trivial (one toggle).
  Blast radius: execute animations only — nothing else reads
  `bHunterPrideKillAnim`. Optional companion: Killmoves ON (if the user
  wants fewer captures at all).
- **Rung 2 (load order/hook priority) — NOT APPLICABLE:** the half-execute
  is not a menu-routing conflict — the menu is Acheron's own perk+SWF, and
  the bug is inside AcheronHunterPride's anim branch; no load-order
  change can reroute it. The only ordering-adjacent variant would be
  INSTALLING a modded paired execution animation set (OAR) so the hug is
  replaced by an actual kill anim — that's an optional content add, not
  a fix, and out of scope.
- **Rung 3 (patch) — available but not needed at Rung 1's cost:** a
  3-line psc/pex patch to AcheronHunterPride.psc option 2 (call
  `akTarget.Kill(PlayerRef)` after the hug-idle fallback, or remove the
  anim branch). Effort: small; blast radius: Acheron's file (upstream
  conflict risk on Acheron updates); NOT RECOMMENDED unless Rung 1 fails
  live. Scoped only if Rungs 1–2 fail per the task list.
- **Chosen rung recommendation: RUNG 1** (Execution Animation OFF), with
  the side-effect analysis above as the reason goal-A is declined for
  now. Awaiting user ruling.

### §50 — Dogfood finding: zip packaging bug and rebuild (2026-09-24)

**Finding:** User reported `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.esp` ABSENT from plugin list after installing the unified alpha. The gate report's manifest confirmed "ESP | 1" in the zip — only one `.esp` shipped. The git tree had both (verified: `git ls-files '*.esp'` returned 2).

**Root cause:** The previous zip was assembled from a manually-curated file list (either a stale patch-era manifest or `7z a` with directory wildcards + explicit root files) that only referenced `SkyrimNet_AnimationsGS.esp` at root. `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.esp` was simply never on the list, even though it was tracked in git at root level.

**Rebuild method:** Changed the zip assembly to derive the file list directly from the git tree:
```
git ls-files | filter (exclude .psc, dll-source/, dll-source-gs/, .git*) |
  write to _zip_list.txt |
  7z a -tzip -mx=9 SN-AnimationsGS-Baka-Unified-v0.1.0-alpha.zip @_zip_list.txt
```
This guarantees 1:1 correspondence between tracked tree and shipped zip, with no stale manifests.

**New reconciliation gate (mandatory, permanent):** A file-by-file reconciliation of the zip against `git ls-files` is now required — every tree file either present in the zip or explicitly listed as source/internal-excluded. Zero unexplained omissions.

**Verification of rebuilt zip:**
- Total tracked: 270 files
- Excluded (source/internal): 50 (15 .psc + 32 dll-source/ + 11 dll-source-gs/ + 3 .git*)
- Included in zip: **220 files** — matches exactly
- `.esp` files: **BOTH** present — `SkyrimNet_AnimationsGS.esp` (1051 bytes) and `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.esp` (9457 bytes)
- Zip size: 5,867,010 bytes (5.6 MB), compressed ratio 5%
- SHA256: `7CC0CA84B86793B4C32B6D2AC38363D55B37FDDF213B784F3B9A22F1AC742E1A`

**Impact:** The old zip (identical name) has been replaced with the corrected version. User will run the FULL dogfood checklist on the rebuilt zip — the first artifact failed, so the smoke-test-only shortcut is void; the rebuild gets a complete pass.

**Context:** SkyrimNet Beta 25 (0.25.0) stops reading `prompts/`, `config/triggers/`, `config/actions/`. Content ships as a plugin folder. **Audit results (93 content files):**
- **Actions (78):** 8 COMPLIANT (capture, escalate, express, flirt, release, spank_butt, struggle, untie), 70 NEEDS-RENAME (in-file `name` PascalCase vs snake_case filename; import-assistant convention = lowercased name, e.g. `arm_hold.yaml`/name`ArmHold` → `armhold.yaml`), 0 INVALID. Special: `cat_snbaka_creature.yaml`(name`Creature`)→`creature.yaml`; `cat_snbaka_downed.yaml`(name`Down`)→`down.yaml`; `cat_sngs_pose.yaml`(name`\"Pose\"`)→`pose.yaml`. - **Knowledge packs (.sknpack):** NONE in tree — no re-export required.

- **Exclusion audit:** no `_saves/`, no `*.dynamic.prompt`, no `characters/dynamic/`; `SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/` holds only `config/`+`prompts/`. PASS.

## §60 — REV-60: dogfood incident investigation (Frabbi stuck in struggle-lost state) — report-only

**Date:** 2026-10-01. **Mode:** report-only (§7) — no builds, no fixes, no state changes.
**Trigger:** REV-59 dogfood gate — user reported ONE incident on an otherwise-PASS session:
after a QTE struggle vs NPC Frabbi (won by the player, Hadrian), the victim stayed stuck
in the "struggle lost" animation, never transitioned to a downed state, and could not be
interacted with again. **Routing (rev-55 rider):** surgery NOT implicated (analysis below)
→ central record, no feature-doc incident section.

### Rotation mapping (verified, not assumed)

Four boots on disk, not two. Internal timestamps + content (Frabbi hit counts):

- `Papyrus.3.log` 03:10:37PM boot, 15KB, 0 Frabbi — pre-dogfood short boot.
- `Papyrus.2.log` 07:54:21PM → 08:03:04PM, 17 Frabbi hits — earlier evening boot (not the incident).
- `Papyrus.1.log` 09:05:38PM → 09:14:54PM, **107 Frabbi hits, tail ends mid-interaction on
  Frabbi — THE INCIDENT BOOT** (confirms the brief's mapping).
- `Papyrus.0.log` 09:16:47PM → 09:26:57PM, 0 Frabbi — category-confirmation boot.

LLM surfaces: `openrouter_input.2026-09-30_19-13-21.log` (spans 07:13PM→09:14:47PM, covers
both evening boots), `openrouter_output.log` + `conversation_log.log` (end 09:14:48/31PM);
boot 2's `openrouter_input.log` is 0 bytes (no LLM traffic — dashboard-check only).

### Incident window (Papyrus.1, quoted sentinels)

- 09:14:00PM `[SNBakaACT] Struggle ENTER` (player-initiated via power) → 09:14:01PM
  `[SNBaka][ACTION] interaction=Struggle type=baka_forced aggressor=Hadrian target=Frabbi`
- 09:14:01PM `[SNBaka] _StartTears: SKIPPED Frabbi — SNBaka.TearsOn already 1 (stuck flag?
  prior scene didn't _StopTears)` — pre-existing tears-flag leak from the 09:13:49 Spanking.
- 09:14:10PM `PlayPairedSequence: starting QTE. A1=Hadrian A2=Frabbi` → 09:14:21PM
  `OnAELGameEnd: afNumArg=1.000000 playerIsVictim=False victimEscaped=False` +
  `PlayPairedSequence: QTE done. complete=TRUE escaped=False` (struggle LOST)
- 09:14:27-28PM `CleanupPair: A1=Hadrian A2=Frabbi hadPlayer=TRUE` → holds released,
  pacify restored, `player controls re-enabled (bSkipA2Reset=TRUE)`
- 09:14:29PM `[SNBaka] Execute: QTE defeated — calling DefeatGroundWindow` →
  `_DefeatGroundWindow: attacker=Hadrian victim=Frabbi window=20.000000` →
  `baka_defeat registered for delegated victim Frabbi` →
  09:14:29PM `silence watch armed for Frabbi (25.000000s)` →
  09:14:30PM **`silence watch: Frabbi no longer downed (resolved by a sanctioned exit) — watch
  standing down`** (1s after arming) → `_DefeatGroundWindow: delegated downed state to Acheron
  for Frabbi`
- 09:14:47PM + 09:14:54PM `[SNBaka][POWER] interact power pressed by Hadrian` →
  `[SNBaka][POWER] target=Frabbi bleedingOut=False` → **silence** (no menu, no blocked
  sentinel, no action) → log ends 09:14:54PM (user quit to boot 2).


### Break point: (a) downed state never SET — delegated into a dead listener

- The delegated branch of `_DefeatGroundWindow` cleared `SNBaka.OnGround/Locked/DownPose/
  GroundWindowAggressor` and handed the victim to `_DelegateDownToAcheron` → requires
  `SNAcheron.Present==1` AND `SNAcheron.Enabled==1` on PlayerRef (StorageUtil, **persists in
  cosave**) → both defeats took the delegated arm, so both flags read 1.
- But the Acheron bridge mod is DISABLED in the Ultra profile: modlist shows
  `-[NoDelete] SkyrimNet-Acheron-Integration-1.2.0 [dead]`; every 09/30 boot logs
  `Cannot open store for class "skyrimnet_acheronintegration" / "Downed_SkyrimNet" … missing
  file?` at save-load (Papyrus.0/1/2 alike). The only copies of those .pex live in the
  disabled mod folder.
- ⇒ `SNAcheron.Present/Enabled` are **stale cosave values** from when the bridge was last
  enabled. `SNBaka_RequestAcheronDown` fires into a void: no bridge script ever sets
  `SNAcheron.Held`, nobody downs the victim, nobody owns recovery. Victim = no downed flags,
  no holder, left holding the last struggle stage (user-visible stuck anim).
- Silence watch then stood down in 1s on a **false positive**: `_AbandonedHoldWatch`'s
  first poll found `_IsDownedAny()==False` (nothing ever set it) and interpreted that as
  "resolved by a sanctioned exit" — it cannot distinguish "never downed" from "recovered".
  Same 1s stand-down after the session's EARLIER defeat (09:12:58PM) — the same dead-bridge
  delegation happened there; the pipeline happened to re-engage ~58s later (09:13:49 Spanking
  via LLM, 09:13:56 power→09:14:00 Struggle ENTER), so no user-visible incident.
- The "cannot interact again" half: power presses reached `Interact_ShowMenu` (no
  `[SNBaka][POWER] blocked —` lines) and died **silently**. `_IsDownedAny(Frabbi)==False`
  rules out the downed menu; the silent return is inside `Interact_ShowMenu`/`IsEligible` —
  several of whose gates log nothing (`akA1.IsInCombat() && !_IsDownedAny(akA2)` is the
  leading candidate), or in the native menu call (this DLL writes SKSE-side logs that are
  **not retained on disk** — no BakaIntegration log file exists in overwrite). The exact
  silent gate is NOT identified from available logs — reported, not guessed.

### LLM cross-reference (three-failure-mode determination)

The `baka_defeat` decision cue registered correctly (visible in
`openrouter_input.2026-09-30_19-13-21.log` context: "exactly ONE of: Escalate … HelpUp …
Release"). The LLM's answer: speaker selection picked the VICTIM — 21:14:31PM streaming
response is Frabbi begging, tagged `ACTION: Down PARAMS: {"intent": "beg for mercy and await
Hadrian's decision to Escalate, HelpUp, or Release"}` → `[action_evaluation] ACTION: None`
(21:14:31PM) → next turn silence (`0`, 21:14:48PM). Later prompts mark Frabbi `[IN SCENE]`
and "IMPORTANT: Do NOT select Frabbi as speaker!". Determination for the could-not-interact
half: follow-ups were **surfaced to the LLM and not executed** (the model role-played the
victim's plea; its non-action resolved to None) — while the player's own power attempts died
in the silent gate above. Not "never surfaced", not "attempted and refused with evidence".


### Good-trace comparison (Task 3b)

Known-good delegated chain (§53, 09-22 session, bridge era): `baka_defeat registered for
delegated victim Hadrian` → silence watch **held** ("locked by a follow-up action" /
"still queued for the Acheron bridge") → **`[SNAcheron:Downed] RunConsequence`** bridge
sentinels → Escalate → wizard → SexLab → `_EscalationCleanup` after each end. The Frabbi
trace is missing EVERY bridge-side line — no Downed consequence, no held-queue stand-down,
no follow-up lock — replaced by a 1s "no longer downed" stand-down. That missing-lines diff
IS the diagnosis: the bridge is absent; the delegation was consumed by nobody.

### Surgery implication (Task 3a) — NOT IMPLICATED

REV-59 diff elements: (1) DLL SNBaka_Pose category registration removal — pose-menu listing
only; the struggle/downed/menu pipeline never reads that category, and DLL exports are
byte-equivalent to the reference build; the same DLL's power/menu machinery demonstrably
worked mid-session (09:13:56 press → 09:14:00 Struggle ENTER). (2) L75 Display prompt
sentence, (3) pose.yaml comment, (4) README step — text/docs only, no runtime reach into
Papyrus state. Deployed .pex byte-match tracked source (244044/2839/1370B). The dead-bridge
condition predates REV-59 (same warnings in the 07:54PM pre-incident boot; `[dead]` folder,
save-load warnings) — **verdict: surgery not implicated; environmental, unlinked pipeline**.

### Verdict + fix proposals (NOT built — §7)

- **Class:** delegated-downed-state failure — stale `SNAcheron.Present/Enabled` cosave flags
  route `_DelegateDownToAcheron` into a disabled bridge (the code's own comments anticipate
  exactly this hazard: "Delegating into that void cleared our local flags with nobody ever
  actually downing the victim").
- **Confidence:** high for the stuck/no-downed half; low for the exact identity of the
  silent interact gate (unlogged gates; DLL-side logs not retained).
- **Reproducible-looking:** deterministic under this modlist state — ANY delegated QTE
  defeat will behave this way (both defeats in this session did); not scene-specific.
- **Fix proposals (for user approval):** (1) liveness handshake — bridge re-stamps
  `SNAcheron.Present` per load, plus a runtime form-check (`Game.GetFormFromFile` on the
  bridge esp) in `_DelegateDownToAcheron` so a stale value cannot route delegation;
  (2) `_AbandonedHoldWatch` "no longer downed" stand-down should require the victim to
  have been observed downed at least once (or a grace poll) before treating absence-of-flags
  as a sanctioned exit; (3) add §5 sentinels to the silent `Interact_ShowMenu`/`IsEligible`
  return paths (combat gate, lock gate) so this class is diagnosable from Papyrus alone;
  (4) user-side immediate remediation: re-enable `SkyrimNet-Acheron-Integration-1.2.0` or
  clear `SNAcheron.Present`/`SNAcheron.Enabled` from StorageUtil. (5) Separate minor bug
  (pre-existing, not incident-causal): `TearsOn` leak — 09:13:49 Spanking's `_StartTears`
  (09:13:55) never got `_StopTears`; flag leaks into the next scene (`SKIPPED … stuck flag?`
  sentinel fired at 09:14:01).

**Assumptions audit:** (1) "Stale cosave flags" is inferred from delegated-arm execution +

## §63 — REV-63: cum-detection + FHU-inflation triggers (build) — 2026-10-01

**Parallel-track ruling of record (verbatim, new):** "dogfood gates SHIPPING, never
building; every feature ships only after its own dogfood; releases carry only
dogfood-passed features; per-rev staged artifacts are frozen and independently
testable." REV-62's artifact remains frozen at
`dist\SN-AnimationsGS-Baka-Unified-REV-62-acheron-fold.zip`; nothing this session
touched it. The REV-63 artifact below INCLUDES the fold (running integration
snapshot) — it covers the fold for convenience, but the fold still needs its own
explicit dogfood pass before any release carries it.

**Task 1 — pattern study (conclusion):** the sdb_ path is: our action script builds
a desc string and calls `SkyrimNetApi.RegisterEvent(eventType, desc, originator,
target)` (SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.psc L8776 spank, L8809 slap); the YAML trigger
keys on `eventCriteria.eventType` only (sdb_spanked/sdb_slapped.yaml). The inbound
leg here (third-party ModEvents) uses the same `RegisterForModEvent` machinery as
the main quest's `_RegisterModEvents()` (L8559+, re-armed from Setup() because
registrations do not survive save/load). Two deviations, both flagged not
improvised: (a) FHU's external-event stack (fhu.EventRegister broadcast +
sr_InfEventBase ReferenceAlias contract, sr_InfEventManager.psc L22-36, L46-61)
requires esp records to join — out of Papyrus-only scope — so level awareness is
the documented FALLBACK poll; (b) a planned standalone listener quest
(SkyrimNet_BakaDetection.psc) was ABORTED pre-commit: a new script needs a new
quest record in the esp to instantiate, violating no-esp-change — the listeners
folded into the EXISTING main quest script instead (spank-system precedent).

**Task 2 — cum detection (2a-ii verdict: PROXY case, evidence-cited):** SexLab has
NO dedicated cum-state surface — no event, no faction, no spell (Cumshot 2 is
mesh/particle only; the framework's own sends are thread lifecycle hooks:
sslThreadModel.SendThreadEvent L2256-2273 pushes "Hook"+Name ModEvents with
(thread_id, HasPlayer); actors resolvable via SexLabUtil/HookActors ->
ThreadSlots.GetController(tid).Positions). So the SL side rides the
`HookStageEnd` proxy with cue wording that claims "release" and NEVER overlay
application. OCum side: `ocum_applied_cum`/`ocum_applied_cum_npc_scene` handlers
(OCumMaleScript.psc L687-706 payloads re-verified). KNOWN LIMITATION (flagged):
Papyrus ModEvent handlers receive only the FIRST push per type — the TARGET
(second Form push) is unrecoverable, so sdb_cum_applied carries originator
(Orgasmer) and target=None; the YAML cue is written to work unnamed. Shared 15s
cum-cue cooldown suppresses OCum HJ/FJ multi-fire and SL StageEnd chains.

**Task 3 — FHU awareness:** reads FHU's OWN state only (StorageUtil
`sr.inflater.amount` per actor + the `sr.inflater.Actors` formlist keyed on the
sr_inflateQuest form — sr_FillHerUp.esp 0x000D63, parsed from BOTH installed esp
binaries, identical). Poll multiplexed onto the main quest's real-time update
slot via `_ArmRealtimeTimer` (RegisterForSingleUpdate REPLACES pending timers —
the old cooldown chain would starve against a poll; cooldown logic itself
unchanged, expiry time-based now). `sr.inflater.start` (parameterless broadcast,
sr_inflateQuest L1891) = immediate-poll nudge. Deflation = amount decreasing
(SpermOut ability path exposes no event). Source-agnostic by design (3b-ii): cues
never assert WHY a level changed. 3e patch assessment (report-only):
"[NoDelete] SL FHU Baka Ostim 0.18" ships a full sr_FillHerUp.esp REPLACEMENT +
6 recompiled scripts (config/messages/quest/thread/FTUDeliveryFrame/OrcPickup)
— it works by FHU's own scripts accepting OStim-side fills; NO conflicts with
what we read (same StorageUtil keys, same quest formID 0x000D63). Its behavior
is a dogfood question, not a design premise.

**Task 4 — module placement:** `SKSE\Plugins\SkyrimNet\external\regalrascal.cum-detection\`

### Task 3 — root cause (all four failure symptoms explained by evidence)

**(A) HEADLINE — all 44 dispatch failures are signature mismatches.** The log
carries exactly 44 `Incorrect number of arguments passed to function
SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.*` errors, by handler: 29× OnSLStageEnd
("Expected 4, got 2"), 7× OnFHUStartSignal ("Expected 4, got 0"), 1×
OnOCumApplied ("Expected 4, got 5"). Ground truth from the INSTALLED
frameworks' push sites:

| Event | Actual push site (installed source) | Pushed args | Our handler | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ocum_applied_cum` | OCumMaleScript L687-695 (ModEvent.Create + Push×5) | Form Orgasmer, Form Target, Float AmountML, String Area, String SceneID | `(String, String, Float, Form)` | "Expected 4, got 5" |
| `ocum_applied_cum_npc_scene` | same L697-706 | Form, Form, **Int ThreadID**, Float, String, String | same | "Expected 4, got 6" (predicted; no NPC-scene climax this session) |
| `HookStageEnd` (+ every Hook* event) | sslThreadModel SetupThreadEvent (SendThreadEvent → ModEvent.Create("Hook"+Name), PushInt(thread_id), PushBool(HasPlayer)) | Int, Bool | `(String, String, Float, Form)` | "Expected 4, got 2" ×29 |
| `sr.inflater.start` | sr_inflateQuest L2149-2150 (ModEvent.Create + Send, no Push) | (none) | `(String, String, Float, Form)` | "Expected 4, got 0" ×7 |

Papyrus `ModEvent.Create/Push*/Send` calls the handler with EXACTLY the pushed
values as typed parameters; the VM rejects the call on arity/type mismatch.
The REV-63 design doc's assumption — "a handler receives the first push of
each type in the 4-slot (eventName, strArg, numArg, sender) form" — is the
SendModEvent convention and is FALSE for the ModEvent.Create API all three
senders use. Events FIRE, handlers NEVER EXECUTE, so no gates, no cooldown
writes, no `SkyrimNetApi.RegisterEvent` calls, no YAML/LLM leg at all.

**(B) FHU level-poll never armed.** `_FHUStartPoll` is called ONLY from
`Setup()`. Setup's sentinel (`[SNBaka] Setup: SexLab installed=`) never appears
in Papyrus.0.log — Setup() did NOT run in the entire session. The heartbeat
only re-runs `_RegisterDecorators()` + `_RegisterModEvents()` (its own
comment: "Setup doesn't run on reload"). So even with correct handler
signatures, the level poll would still be dead after every load.

**(C) MCM toggles absent (§63 checklist item 6) — save-bound SKI cache.**
The deployed MCM pex is the v4 build (AF11B153; GetVersion 4, OnVersionUpdate
→ _BuildPages) but: no `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration_MCM.OnVersionUpdate` /
`OnGameReload` dispatch appears in the log at save-load (08:23:45) — while
other MCM quests demonstrably received their OnGameReload (VIGILANT,
SimplestHorses, DynamicActivationKey traces present). When the user opened
MCM at 08:24:30 the running config served the SAVE-CACHED v3 page build:
`Method SetOptionHighlightText not found on SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration_MCM`
errors (a stale-instance symptom) and no new toggles. This is the classic SKI
config-cache behavior the §63 version-bump was supposed to force — the bump
is correctly in the pex, but the OnVersionUpdate that consumes it never
fired. **The user's not-yet-tried SKI/MCM reset (exit to main menu / MCM
"Reset" per SkyUI docs) is now THE decisive test** — if toggles appear after
it, (C) is confirmed as environment-cache, not code.


**(D) MCM OnGameReload → Setup() chain is the single point of failure linking
(B) and (C).** The MCM's `OnGameReload` (which calls `Main.Setup()`) has no
execution evidence this session; its absence explains BOTH the dead FHU poll
arming AND the unbumped MCM page. Root-cause candidates (not separable from
this log alone): (i) the save-serialized SKI config instance not receiving
reload dispatch, (ii) the `Main` property unbound on the stale instance,
(iii) dispatch not yet processed when the session ended. Fix (2) below makes
the code robust against all three.

**Per-path break-point verdicts (Task 4a):** OCum/SL/FHU-start — events FIRE
(44 VM dispatch errors prove the senders worked); break point is
handler-signature rejection in the VM, one level earlier than "not received."
FHU-levels — break point is poll never armed (Setup never ran). LLM leg —
never entered (no sdb_cum/sdb_fhu string in openrouter_input/output or
conversation logs — Task 3e verified 0 matches; the trigger YAMLs were never
exercised because no event reached them).

**Audit item 4 closed (OCum 0x800):** OCum.esp binary parsed this session —
ESL-flagged, master-index 03; on-disk QUST formID 0x03000800 → relative ID
0x800 = `OCumQuest` (EDID parsed from the record). The §63 presence-probe
GUESS is CORRECT. (FHU 0xD63 was already binary-parsed in rev-63; both esp
variants confirmed on disk this session.)

### Fix proposal (report-only; NO code changed this session)

1. **(A) — rewrite the three handler signatures to match the installed
   senders' actual ModEvent pushes:**
   `OnOCumApplied(Form akOrgasmer, Form akTarget, Float afAmountML, String asArea, String asSceneID)`
   (OCum target); separate registration or a variant handler for the 6-arg
   `ocum_applied_cum_npc_scene` (Int ThreadID third);
   `OnSLStageEnd(Int aiThreadID, Bool abHasPlayer)` (SL);
   `OnFHUStartSignal()` (zero params). BONUS: the OCum TARGET (second Form
   push) IS recoverable with the corrected signature — the §63
   "Target-unrecoverable" limitation and its None-target cue workaround
   dissolve. RegisterForModEvent(event, handler) names unchanged.
2. **(B)+(D) — decouple FHU poll arming from Setup():** move the
   `If bFHUInflationEnabled && _FHUInstalled() → _FHUStartPoll()` block into
   the `OnUpdateGameTime` heartbeat next to `_RegisterModEvents()` (the
   idempotent guard inside `_FHUStartPoll` prevents double-arming), so the
   poll self-heals within one heartbeat even when the MCM reload path is
   stale.
3. **(C) — user-side:** SKI/MCM reset (main-menu exit or the MCM config
   reset) to flush the save-bound config instance; re-dogfood checklist item
   6. If toggles then appear, no MCM code change is needed.
4. Re-run the FULL §63 dogfood checklist on the fixed build; the 44-error
   signature becomes: 0 `Incorrect number of arguments` lines.

   `scenes=0False` concatenation suggests a counter+bool string bug worth

## §67 — Module contract ruling (user-approved, 2026-10-02): forwarding-events refinement for the unified motherboard/module architecture

**Scope:** records-only rev (no build). The four-point forwarding-events
refinement for the unified Baka + GS Poses + Acheron + SL/FHU integration
was **user-approved in full** and is now the module contract of record.
Full text lives in `docs/features/fomod.md` (architecture section); this
central entry records the cross-feature ruling per the rev-55 routing
rider.

**The canonical module contract (user-mandated, all four points):**

1. **ModEvents are Form members (engine constraint).** Papyrus `ModEvent`s
   must be registered on a runtime-existing Form; they cannot live on a
   recordless script. ModEvents must be stated explicitly. Consequence:
   the forwarding event surface must be explicitly stated on the
   motherboard quest record.
2. **The motherboard quest owns the thin forwarding-event surface.**
   Registration, forwarding, sentinel logging — no feature logic on the
   motherboard.
3. **Recordless module scripts hold the logic and state** (logic +
   StorageUtil state; e.g. BakaSL, Acheron bridge modules).
4. **Modules receive lifecycle calls, never raw registrations.** The
   motherboard calls module lifecycle entry points (arm/disarm/handshake
   per established patterns); modules register nothing directly on
   foreign events.

**Standing consequences recorded with the ruling:**

- Applies to **every current and future module** — Baka, GS Poses,
  Acheron, SL/FHU forwarding, and any later addition.
- **Sentinel/event parity IDENTICAL across integrations** (standing
  discipline, restated with this ruling).
- **Phase B build** (forwarding-events surface on the motherboard quest;
  modules get lifecycle calls) proceeds per this contract.
- Two-source ESP verification (espdump3 + xEdit GUI load) for any ESP
  changes remains the standing gate.
- **Phase D records pass must record the compile-bat naming correction:**
  `tools\compile\compile_baka.bat` is a private-home script; the stub
  tree is the compile flow of record — do not conflate.

**Context:** pre-Phase-B approval session. Prior verification work
(espdump3.py ESP audits of all three ESPs — clean; script source review
of SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.psc ~9.9K lines, MCM scripts, BakaSL,
SNBakaUI; heartbeat/timer-pattern and MCM versioning audits) supports
this ruling; obsolete espdump.py/espdump2.py were removed.

**Commit state (this rev):** GS repo `gs-muse-redesign` — §67 + fomod.md
architecture section + INDEX row update in this commit. Fork
`new-features` untouched by this records step (Phase B build is the next
fork-touching step, at HEAD `202cce2`/REV-65, clean tree).

## REV-69 (2026-10-02) — deploy-integrity restoration + mirror drift fix (user rulings, this session)

**Ruling 1 — stale pex promoted to D&D defect fix.** The REV-68 deploy folder AND the
fork tree carried a stale REV-63-shape `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.pex` (SHA256 head
`E537B692FE69`, 259772b) while the source `.psc` had advanced through REV-65
(`202cce2`) and REV-68 (`7ec7f71`).

- **Root cause (post-mortem):** fork git history is conclusive — the pex last changed
  at `04a7895` (REV-63); the REV-65 and REV-68 sessions updated the `.psc`, compiled
  successfully (0/0), staged "artifacts", and described deploy verification as
  "8/8 pex fork==deploy hash MATCH" — but the compile OUTPUT was never copied back
  into the fork tree nor re-committed, and the deploy folder was built from that stale
  fork tree. The fork==deploy check was a CONSISTENCY check (both copies agreed) — it
  cannot catch a stale binary when both sides carry the same stale bytes. There was no
  SOURCE-TO-BINARY freshness check (psc mtime/commit vs pex hash-of-record).
- **Fix executed:** recompile from the fixed source via the canonical bat
  (`tools\compile\compile_baka.bat`, GS private home) — 0 errors / 0 warnings on all
  three scripts; fresh build output hashed FROM BUILD OUTPUT at deploy time: Integration
  `A47D3CCDB975` (260960b), `_MCM` `04FDEBBFDEF0` (37251b), `BakaSL` `1E22B3C2E7E1`
  (7624b). Binary-string audit: fresh pex carries the REV-65 detection sentinel and
  `OnSLStageEnd`/`aiThreadID` signatures; the stale REV-63 sentinel string is ABSENT —
  the shape defect is confirmed and the fix verified in-binary, not just by hash.
- **Deploy (never-update-in-place, per the REV-68 amended convention):** fresh stamped
  folder `D:\Modlists\LoreRim\mods\SN-AnimationsGS-Baka-Unified-REV-69-deploy-integrity\`
  (full REV-68 tree copy, 249 files, + the 3 fresh pex; MO2 closed at deploy time per
  rev-42 rider — user closed it on request). §1/§2 verification: 38/38 Scripts tree
  files + 3/3 esp hash MATCH (3 pex vs build output; 35 vs fork). REV-68 folder retired
  (user disables in MO2; retained for rollback).
- **Fork restoration:** the 3 stale pex in the fork tree were also replaced with the
  fresh build output and committed (`8b67acd`, branch `new-features`).
- **Lesson (standing):** a fork==deploy hash match proves CONSISTENCY, not FRESHNESS.
  Any deploy gate that verifies pex must hash FROM BUILD OUTPUT (or record a psc-commit →
  pex-hash-of-record lineage), never fork-tree pex vs deploy pex alone. This closes the
  REV-68 verification gap that let a REV-63 binary ship inside a REV-68 deploy. Rides on
  ruleset §2 (post-deploy resolution check) as an interpretation note; numbered rule
  count stays 10.

**Ruling 2 — mirror drift fixed.** Canonical ruleset
(`C:\Users\Tristan\.cline\data\workspaces\chat\gs-build\SkyrimNet-Animations-GS\docs\STANDING_RULESET.md`)
lacked the §7 rider (REV-68 FOMOD/manifest titles, "Delectatio et Dominium"); the fork
carried it. Synced fork → canonical; SHA256 head `DE621A6F4BF4` MATCH on both. FILE_STRUCTURE
mirror also drifted: the fork lacked the REV-68 §4 deploy-target amendment, §6 (Papyrus
compile bat private home) and the REV-69 lineage holder update; canonical §2 said fork
branch `main` while the fork has worked on `new-features` since REV-59 (corrected with
verification note). Canonical → fork synced, fork-only case-redress pointer retained
(`fbaadfd`).

**Ruling 3 — confirmation step:** quarantined into the case's next-observation notes
(see `GSA\case-redress\CASE_FILE.md` REV-70 section); no dedicated session. Case file
cross-refs this record only.

## §73 — REV-73 (2026-10-02): REV-72 dogfood MCM failure — migration mechanism root-caused, report-only

**User report:** post-REV-68-era dogfood session — the Baka MCM did NOT show expected new sections (Acheron-bridge consolidation, SlaveTats section); no SlaveTats surface at all. Contradicts the REV-68 migration design (GetVersion bump + markers), which was built specifically because OnVersionUpdate proved unreliable on stale saves.

### Task 1 — session identification

- Failing session = **Papyrus.0.log, 2026-10-02 17:41:51 → 17:51:08** (606,912 B; log-open first line, SeverActions tick last). Today's 4 logs (13:49 → 17:51) read in full.
- **Build identified: REV-72 pre-fix (`a14dc89`)** — evidence: (a) `[SNBaka] module-arm: SlaveTats presence=TRUE NG=TRUE` + `arm pass complete` sentinels (17:46:54) exist ONLY in the REV-72 motherboard; (b) Papyrus.1's module-arm lines have NO SlaveTats line → pre-REV-72 motherboard (REV-69) in the earlier sessions. Papyrus.0 = the dogfood session.
- Deployed-pex check (Task 2d, REV-69 freshness discipline): the live REV-72 folder's current pex is the **post-fix** `25D4A8B613DB868F` (written 17:54, AFTER session end) — but `git a14dc89:Scripts/SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration_MCM.pex` hashes **`E6E83D44E9CC75BF`** and **contains the `SNBaka.ST.MCMv6` string / GetVersion 6** (binary-verified). Ultra modlist (L67) enables REV-72 only (69/68/65/63 disabled). **NOT a stale deploy.**

### Task 2 — the migration trace

**2a. The version/marker machinery appears NOWHERE — not in the failing session and not in ANY of the four logs.** Grep totals (all four logs): `SNBaka.ST.MCMv6` 0; `SNBaka.MCMConsolidated` 0; `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration_MCM` 0 — zero lines from our MCM script (no `INITIALIZED`, no `INITIALIZE` errors, no OnConfigInit/OnPageReset/OnVersionUpdate); `OnVersionUpdate` 0 anywhere. Contrast: other MCM config quests demonstrably received their events — `SKI_PlayerLoadGameAlias.OnPlayerLoadGame()` fired 6× for DynamicActivationKeyMCM, 3× for SimplestHorses_MCM, plus OBodyNG/OSex/stances; SimplestHorses_MCM.OnConfigInit also fired. Our quest is the ONLY silent one. **Classification: mode (i) — the check never ran.**

**2b. WHY the check never ran (root cause, mechanism-cited):**

1. `SKI_QuestBase.psc` (SkyUI canonical source): `OnVersionUpdate` fires only from `CheckVersion()`, which is called ONLY from `SKI_ConfigBase.OnGameReload()` (and from `OnInit()` → `OnGameReload()` — the cold-boot path).
2. `OnGameReload` delivery to a config quest requires the quest to carry **a player ReferenceAlias with `SKI_PlayerLoadGameAlias` attached** (SkyUI source comment: "Helper to add reload event to quest: 1. Create quest 2. Add player alias 3. Attach SKI_PlayerLoadGameAlias"). The alias's `OnPlayerLoadGame()` → `(owningQuest as SKI_QuestBase).OnGameReload()`.
3. **`SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.esp` has NO `SKI_PlayerLoadGameAlias`** — binary string-grep negative, and negative across **ALL 10 deployed esp copies** (v0.1.0-alpha, v0.2.0, REV-56/59/61/63/65/68/69/72) — **inherited from the original v2.0.7-era esp, never present**.
4. On an EXISTING save: `OnInit` does not fire (quest already initialized when the save was made; script state serialized) and `OnGameReload` never fires (no alias). The ConfigManager's registration loop (`SKICP_configManagerReady` → `RegisterMod`) re-registers the menu but calls only `OnConfigRegister` — **never `CheckVersion()`** (SKI_ConfigManager.psc read in full). So `CurrentVersion` in the save-cached instance stays frozen, `Pages[]` stays the save-cached build, and no version bump can ever take effect on that save. On a FRESH save, `OnInit` fires and everything works — why dev-side behavior looked correct while the Hadrian-era save never migrates.

**Also resolved:** §64's "(D) MCM OnGameReload → Setup()" mystery — our MCM's `OnGameReload` (MCM.psc L90–95, calls `Main.Setup()`) has NEVER fired on an existing save (same missing-alias cause); explains §64/§65's "Setup() never runs at load". The MCM.psc L86–89 comment ("SkyUI MCM quests DO reliably receive OnGameReload on every load") is **FALSE for this esp** — true only for quests with the alias. The REV-72 dogfood "Phase 1 module-arm line" expectation was met ONLY because the motherboard's own `OnUpdateGameTime` heartbeat (L8853+) independently calls `_ArmModules()`.

**2c.** N/A (mode (i) — the version-bump → page-rebuild chain never starts). For the record, the intact chain when it CAN run: `CheckVersion()` → `CurrentVersion(5) < 6` → `OnVersionUpdate(6)` (L114–131: writes `SNBaka.ST.MCMv6`; `SNBaka.MCMConsolidated=5` if `aVersion<5`; `_BuildPages()` L130 → L133–141) → `OnPageReset("Plugins")` (L143+) renders the ST section (L300–313, presence-gated on `SNBaka_SlaveTatsModule.Installed()`). All verified present in the deployed pex.

**2d.** Done in Task 1 — deployed pex was the correct v6 build; NOT a freshness failure.

### Task 3 — verdict + records

**Verdict: the mechanism is CORRECT but structurally unreachable on existing saves — broken-at-esp, not broken-at-script; never-deployed is ruled out. The cosave-MCM issue is NOT solved.** The REV-68 design (bump + markers) was sound Papyrus but assumed the delivery vehicle (OnGameReload/OnInit via the alias) exists; it does not, and has not since v2.0.7. The §64/§65 "stale-instance" class is confirmed as this SAME root cause: the save-serialized config instance is never told to re-check its version because nothing ever calls its OnGameReload/CheckVersion.

**Fix proposal (report-only, per §7 — NOT built):**
1. **Primary (rev-55 rider — real toolchain):** add a player ReferenceAlias running `SKI_PlayerLoadGameAlias` to the `SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration_MCM` quest in the esp (CK or xEdit). This restores the SkyUI-intended delivery — `OnGameReload` on every load → `CheckVersion()` → v5/v6 markers fire once on the Hadrian save → `_BuildPages()` rebuild → sections appear — and ALSO revives the dead `Main.Setup()`-on-load chain (§64 (B) defect class: FHU poll arming) for free. Esp-record changes propagate to existing saves (alias data is esp content, applied at load — no cosave migration needed).
2. **Script-only alternative rejected:** the motherboard has no property reference to the MCM quest (grep — comments only), `OnInit` will never re-fire on a save-cached instance, and ConfigManager does no version dispatch; there is no reliable script-only path to reach the stale instance's CheckVersion. An MCM-Helper JSON migration would be a different architecture, not a fix.
3. **Fix dogfood probes:** at Hadrian-save load, grep `MCM v6: SlaveTats degradation-set section added` + `MCM v5: Acheron-bridge settings consolidated` (one or both, depending on the save's last-seen version) in Papyrus.0.log; then run the full §72 checklist.

**Central (cross-feature) per rev-55 routing:** affects MCM migration (all sections incl. Acheron §68), the Setup-at-load chain (§64), and all future config-quest work — recorded here; no single feature doc owns it. slavetats.md dogfood status: blocked-pending-MCM-fix (checklist items 1–2 depend on this).

**Assumptions audit (§8):**
1. Failing session = Papyrus.0 (17:41–17:51): inferred from timestamps, the REV-72-only ST module-arm sentinel, and the user report ordering. Session-time deployed pex reconstructed from git `a14dc89` (E6E83D44) — direct hash impossible (folder pex overwritten 17:54 post-fix); timeline + ST sentinel make REV-72-active certain.

3. SkyUI citations from schlangster/skyui master `dist/Data/Scripts/Source` (SKI_QuestBase / SKI_PlayerLoadGameAlias / SKI_ConfigBase / SKI_ConfigManager, fetched 2026-10-02, read in full); assumed behaviorally identical to installed SkyUI SE. Notably this also corrects our compile-stub view: the GamePlugin headers' `SKI_QuestBase` stub omits `CheckVersion`'s script-side implementation (native-only stubs) — the stub audit rider stands, but version-dispatch semantics come from the real source above.

Corroborates slavetats.md L22 ("full REV-69 tree copy 249 files") vs REV-68's 250-entry tree.

**Task 2 — SlaveTats discovery failure (B): diagnosis COMPLETE, cause isolated.**
- 2a session-log evidence (Papyrus.0.log, 18:52–18:59 today): refresh sentinel
  healthy — `[SNBaka.ST] RefreshPacks: rebuilt cache — 18 sections discovered`
  (11 fires 18:56:59→18:59:31; 18 ≈ user's ~16 pack folders + defaults).
  Module-arm line: `presence=TRUE NG=TRUE` (18:52:23); `tattoo.picker`
  service present=TRUE. One framework-internal error in window:
  18:55:41 `Native function apply_overlay_ex … could find no matching
  function on linked type SlaveTatsNG` (NG-internal bind error, not ours).
  NO ApplyTattoo/PickerChoice lines — the picker never presented data.
- 2b call-path audit vs the INSTALLED framework (NG 0.8.2 wins MO2 priority;
  SE 1.3.9 also present): `SlaveTats.psc` (NG install, Source\Scripts) is a
  pure forwarder to `SlaveTatsNG.*`. **Critical divergence found in
  `release_cache()` L65-67: NG drops `.SlaveTatsNG.cache`, NOT SE's
  `.SlaveTats.cache`** — our stub's release path matches NG's surface
  (signature-identical), so suspects (i)/(iii) are REFUTED at the signature
  level: compile_cache/acquire_cache/release_cache/query_available_tattoos
  all exist with our expected signatures. The defect is suspect (ii): the
  **cache shape**.
- **2c comparison test (decisive, from the same log/session):** SlaveTatsNG's
  own MCM enumerated packs fine (`SlaveTatsNG-MCM - area=BODY, slots=6`,
  face, Hands…; `area/slot/sections: face/0/31061`-style reads) while our
  picker returned nothing to pick. Its enumeration source —
  `SlaveTatsMCMMenu.psc` (NG 0.8.2, L49-66 `_setup_sections`) — reads the
  cache as `cache → JMap.getObj(cache,"default") → domain →
  JMap.getObj(domain, area) → area-map whose KEYS are sections → each
  section's value is a **JArray of entry objects** (`JArray.getObj(tats,i)` →
  `JMap.getStr(entry,"section")`). Our module (`GetSetNames` L596-629, and
  `GetSections`' sibling) reads the section value as a **JMap keyed by tattoo
  name** (`JMap.allKeysPArray(sec)` on the section object) — the legacy-SE
  shape. Under NG, `JMap.allKeysPArray(<a JArray-handle>)` returns nothing,
  so every section yields zero names; `BuildMenuJSON` then emits zero
  sections (L448 `names.Length > 0` gate) — an empty picker with a healthy
  cache. Suspect (iv) NG-vs-SE divergence = the root cause, manifesting via
  (ii): the section node's inner shape differs (SE: name-keyed map; NG:
  array of entry objects).
- **FIX PROPOSAL (next build rev, user-approved):** in
  `SNBaka_SlaveTatsModule.psc`, make section-entry enumeration
  shape-tolerant: if `JValue.typeOf(sec)` says array → iterate
  `JArray.count/getObj` and collect `JMap.getStr(entry,"name")`; if map →
  current `JMap.allKeysPArray` path (SE compatibility retained). Apply in
  `GetSections`/`GetSetNames`/`_EnumerateSections` (the count already works
  because it counts area-map keys, not names). Compile 0/0 + stub audit
  (`JValue.typeOf`, `JMap.getStr`, `JArray.getObj` against NG source), ship
  per the dist rider above. **Retest steps:** same save → MCM SlaveTats page
  → Refresh (expect "N sections", N=18) → open set-picker → section tiles
  populate → pick a spank set → spank event → apply sentinel + in-game
  overlay; downed-menu Apply Tattoo → picker mode → immediate apply on
  bound actor; comparison leg: SlaveTats' own MCM list vs our picker list
  should now enumerate the same packs.
- Watch item folded into retest: NG's `apply_overlay_ex` bind error
  (18:55:41) — if simple_add_tattoo fails at apply time under NG 0.8.2, the
  ApplyTattoo FAILED sentinel will surface it (logged, not swallowed).

"GS<n>|description|category" (GS psc OnPoseSelected L250+ comment L341-342),
and `_VibeTimeout`/`_VibeCSV`/`_VibeEventsFor` key off the same ids (the muse
half), making the id list an INTRA-GS contract (poses.js ids == psc vibe
tables). **Per-side split impact: ZERO** for Baka (it never reads poses.js);
GS keeps the file; the only split-sensitive element is the id-string contract
staying in sync with the GS psc tables (same side, both files).

### Task 3.3 — the DLL boundary (native-function census)

**SNAnimGS_UI.dll (dll-source-gs):** registers exactly 3 Papyrus natives —
`SNAnimGSUI.{IsAvailable, OpenPoseGrid, ClosePoseGrid}`
(PapyrusFunctions.cpp L21-23). Callers: SkyrimNet_AnimationsGS.psc ONLY
(L234-239). Hosts GSAnim_Menu (its only view). No SkyrimNet C++ API usage, no
category registration, no Baka symbols. **VERDICT: GS-ONLY in practice**
(already separable — REV-88 module-map claim CONFIRMED).

**SkyrimNet_BakaIntegration.dll (dll-source):** registers 15 Papyrus natives
on SNBakaUI (PapyrusFunctions.cpp L138-152; stub surface SNBakaUI.psc L10-91:
GetOffset/ReloadOffsets, IsAvailable, ShowInteractMenu, GetInteractTarget,
SetNoCollision, IsCraftingTemptation, ShowEncounterMenu, ShowDownedMenu,
ShowMidCombatMenu, ShowSexSpankMenu, GetLastHitAggressor, SetGetUpCharge,
ShowSlaveTatsMenu, ShowExecuteConfirm). Callers: the motherboard + MCM + ST
module — ALL Baka-side. PLUS the SkyrimNet bridge (6 categories,
SkyrimNetBridge.cpp) and the HitEventSink (defeated-execution lane,
OnDefeatedExecuted motherboard L9112). Hosts 4 views (all Baka content). **One
cross-side nuance: the DLL registers Baka-side categories the GS pose YAMLs
never touch; the DLL is Baka-carrying but NOT GS-carrying.**

**VERDICT: the DLL boundary is genuinely SEPARABLE TODAY** — two DLLs, zero
shared exports, zero shared views, zero shared state; the REV-88 boundary
piece (4) phrase "the shared PrismaUI grid categories span both
(BuildMenuJSON category surfaces)" is IMPRECISE (flag F4 below): the grid's
categories are poses.js view data (GS-only); BuildMenuJSON is the ST picker's
JSON (Baka module); NO DLL-level category surface spans both sides.

### Task 4.1 — registration-mechanism truth (framework evidence per claim)

- **YAML customCategory reference:** the action YAML sets
  `customCategory: <id>`; a category DEFINITION may itself be a YAML "action"
  with `name` + `customCategory` + description + `enabled` (our pose.yaml /
  down.yaml / creature.yaml; CONTENT_ROOTS.md L15: `actions/` root, filename
  == name). Cite: the three def files + the SexLab pack's member YAMLs (e.g.
  sexlab_comfort_general.yaml `customCategory: sexlab_comfort`).
- **DLL RegisterOne:** the Baka DLL registers 6 top-level categories at
  kDataLoaded via `PublicRegisterCPPSubCategory`
  (SkyrimNetBridge.cpp L38-52; PublicAPI.h L102-122: "Register an action
  subcategory for organizational grouping"). YAML actions nest by matching
  the id string (SkyrimNetBridge.cpp L38-39 comment). Both channels
  coexist (pose.yaml L6-8). Historical note: the DLL's SNBaka_Pose
  registration was the pre-REV-59 second channel; removed §59.
- **Idempotency/last-writer:** NO framework documentation found for either
  channel's collision semantics (DevKit beta26-rc4 = 6 modding docs + 2 tools
  + README — zero `customCategory` docs; grep receipt §8). Our own precedent
  evidence: Papyrus RegisterDecorator is documented idempotent (cheatsheet;
  motherboard L9154-9156); the DLL re-registers every init (single-channel,
  no observable conflict). UNSETTLED: same-load dual registration of one id.
- **"Check first" API surface:** the Papyrus SkyrimNetApi exposes NO
  category-query function (call surface = RegisterDecorator/RegisterEvent/
  RegisterShortLivedEvent/ExecuteAction/UnregisterAction/SetActionCooldown/
  SendCustomPromptToLLM/GenerateNPCThought/DirectNarration — full distinct-
  call grep, §8). The C++ PublicAPI has no category-query export either
  (PublicAPI.h declaration census, §8). `PublicHasDecorator` exists (v5+,
  PublicAPI.h L482) — DECORATOR query only, not category.

### Task 4.2 — the seed's open questions, answered or bounded

- **(a) Same-load race:** the framework does NOT serialize or document
  cross-plugin registration order. DLL registrations run at kDataLoaded
  (PublicAPI.h L14-16 "initialization timing"); YAML defs load when content
  packs are scanned (beta25+ external layer, CONTENT_ROOTS.md L3-7). With ONE
  pack there is no race today; under separation, two def sites for the same id
  = UNSETTLED collision semantics + no deterministic tiebreak documented.
  BOUNDED: the design avoids the race instead of resolving it (4.3).
- **(b) Query-before-register:** NO category-existence query exists in either
  API (4.1). The seed's "check if present first" is NOT implementable against
  a first-class API; the nearest instrument is `PublicHasDecorator`
  (C++-only, decorator-scoped). BOUNDED: presence-gating must ride OUR
  surface (the StorageUtil service registry / GetFormFromFile), not the
  framework's.
- **(c) YAML-static vs script-dynamic for the shared category:** YAML-static
  = zero script bytes, rides the content pack, but is per-pack (each side
  carrying a def = the (a) race; one side carrying it = the orphaned-members
  risk R2). Script-dynamic = no Papyrus category-registration API EXISTS
  (only the C++ PublicRegisterCPPSubCategory), so "script-dynamic" means a
  DLL-side RegisterOne in whichever side's DLL — costs a DLL build + keeps
  the kDataLoaded timing class. Cited: PublicAPI.h declaration census.
- **(d) Uninstall ordering:** UNTESTED and UNDOCUMENTED. Predicted from the
  `enabled: false` evidence (down.yaml L7-15: disabling the def strips ALL
  member actions from the rendered menu regardless of their own eligibility):
  removing the def's side leaves member YAMLs orphaned -> members vanish from
  the LLM menu (degrade, not crash — the same vanish class). Members do NOT
  re-home (no re-parenting mechanism documented). BOUNDED: verified by the
  4.3 test's leg 2 before S1 ships.

### Task 4.3 — DESIGN VERDICT (registration pattern of record)

**The evidence CANNOT settle (a)/(d)** — no framework docs on collision or
orphan semantics, no query API. **TWO candidate patterns carried, per the
brief:**

- **P1 — SINGLE-OWNER YAML DEF (default plan):** exactly ONE side's pack
  carries pose.yaml (owner = the GS pack, following the category's SNGS_
  prefix + GS-vibe majority + the muse consumer; FINAL = D3/D4 user
  rulings). The other side's member YAMLs reference the id only. No race
  (one def site); orphan risk bounded by the (d) prediction + the test.
- **P2 — DLL-REGISTERED SHARED DEF:** a RegisterOne-class registration in
  ONE side's DLL (PublicRegisterCPPSubCategory), members reference the id.
  Costs a DLL build; timing class = kDataLoaded; same single-owner property.

**Discriminating test (dogfood-class, named for the era-end):** with BOTH
esps installed, dashboard-visible: (leg 1) duplicate-def probe — temporarily
copy pose.yaml into both sides' packs, load, inspect the dashboard's category
list for a duplicate SNGS_Pose / log warnings; (leg 2) orphan probe — disable
ONLY the def's pack, load, check the Eligible Actions render: if members
vanish silently (predicted) the (d) bound holds; if they error, R2 escalates.
Outcome routes P1 vs P2 (e.g. leg-1 duplicates = benign-last-writer favors
P1-with-tolerant-copying; duplicates = breakage favors strict single-def P1
or the DLL route P2). Test runs era-end (user dogfood class; both esps
installed).

and the Acheron layer were absent. Defect class: content-layer manifest/folder
identity — the REV-103 pack-split shipped layers whose folder/manifest pairings
violate the DevKit layer rule, so the loader skips them silently (CONTENT_ROOTS.md
L33: a failing external layer logs a warning naming the directory and skips).

**Rule of record (DevKit beta26-rc4 `MIGRATING_TO_BETA25.md` L193-194/L226/L254-262):**
`id` = `author.slug` (lowercase, letters/digits/`_`/`-`, exactly one dot); the
**folder name must equal the id**; on mismatch the whole layer is rejected. The
validator enforces the same (filename-is-identity for actions too, compared
case-insensitively vs the in-file `name:`).

  is CK-property-bound and resolves; (2) struggle path evaluates packages TWICE around the hold
  (pre-drain + post-apply) and StopTranslation kills in-flight travel - our fire leg has no
  StopTranslation and (when broken) no package at all, only DontMove/Sandbox, which the REV-139
  dogfood proved does not stop in-flight package pathing; (3) struggle repositions BOTH actors
  (MoveTo) after the stop - our solo fire leaves the actor wherever mid-travel; (4) animation
  class: struggle = PAIRED full-body (both actors bound), pose = SOLO idle on a possibly-mid-walk
  actor. SexLab/FHU both avoid the glide chiefly by precondition (actor already at rest /
  pathing complete before the freeze), not by a stronger primitive.

**R.3 RECOMMENDED FIX SHAPE (user rules; NOT built):** (a) minimal: the one-line formID fix
L493 0x1E6 -> 0xD6A + split the UNAVAILABLE sentinel into probe-miss vs form-miss (two
distinguishable lines) so the miss class is never ambiguous again - the [REV-139] dogfood
already established the DoNothing override is the one missing primitive for in-flight pathing;
(b) optional hardening, user ruling required: port the struggle-order fragments to the fire leg
(StopTranslation + a pre-hold EvaluatePackage drain) IF glides persist after (a). No DLL/esp
need in either shape. **Modlist writes this rider: NONE.**

## SS162 - REV-137e (2026-10-22): PACKAGE-HOLD FORMID FIX + SENTINEL SPLIT

Fix shape (a) ONLY, per the REV-137d-R rider R.1 verdict and the user's ruling on the
fix shape; fix shape (b) RULED OUT this rev (held behind the post-fix dogfood: it rides
the NEXT rev IFF glide/judder on mid-walk actors persists on the [REV-142] dogfood --
the SS161 Task 10 R.2 order-of-operations table is the port spec if invoked).

### 1. The fix (SkyrimNet_AnimationsGS.psc, GS-repo + fork mirror, byte-identical parity)
- L493: `Game.GetFormFromFile(0x1E6, ...)` -> `0xD6A` (the esp's local index after its
  4 masters; full formID 0x04000D6A, EDID SNBakaDoNothing, hex receipt offsets +4963/
  4993 from the rider). ONE literal change; the L477 comment's "PACK 0x1E6" was
  corrected to cite 0xD6A with the misparse note (same wrong-literal class as the code).
- Sentinel split: the single ambiguous `package hold UNAVAILABLE` miss (one latch,
  GSAnim.PkgMiss) is now TWO independently-latched, once-per-load miss classes:
  PROBE-MISS (`GSAnim.PkgProbeMiss` -- busy.baka-half service absent = Baka module
  not present) vs FORM-MISS (`GSAnim.PkgFormMiss` -- half present, DoNothing package
  unresolved; the message says "check the formID literal"). Old sentinel string and
  GSAnim.PkgMiss key byte-verified ABSENT from the new pex.
- NOTHING ELSE: no StopTranslation, no EvaluatePackage drain port, no hold-order/
  interval/pool/cadence changes, no user-facing surface touched (trace-only strings,
  ASCII).

### 2. Records-hygiene note (user instruction 4, standing guard)
The REV-137c "hex-verified" note was itself the defect: it read the PACK record's
DATA-SIZE field (+4) as the formID; the formID lives at +12 (0x04000D6A). A receipt
that misreads the record header is the same class as the bug it "verified" -- the
sentinel split is the standing guard: any future miss now names its own class instead
of collapsing probe-miss and form-miss behind one ambiguous line.

### 3.1 PANEL-WIDTH FIX (receipt)
Diagnosis: `SNBaka_Menu/index.html` #panel is WIDTH-fixed (420px, min 380 /
max 460) with content-UNBOUNDED height, scaled by CSS `zoom` (base 1.5, user
0.6-2.0 via snbakaBumpScale); `body{overflow:hidden}` clips whatever the
zoomed panel pushes past the PrismaUI viewport. The REV-147 no-target session
adds the overlay row on top of the full greyed tab/action grid - at higher
ui-scale that pushes the panel past the viewport and the FOOTER buttons
(Mephala/Molag/Cancel - the exact buttons that stay live per the no-target
ruling) clip off-screen: "does not fit its buttons."
Fix (auto-height per content, viewport-capped): (a) `#panel` gains
`max-height: calc(100vh / var(--sn-zoom, 1.5))` + flex-column - the cap divides
by the LIVE zoom factor so the scaled panel never exceeds 100vh;
